zh.headline: AI 烧钱担忧引发科技股抛售
headline_alt: Anthropic IPO 或遭垃圾级评级
四大厂联手推出 AI 抓取退出标准
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是资本与信任的双重收紧：Anthropic IPO 可能拿到垃圾级评级、科技股因 AI 烧钱担忧集体下挫，融资端的乐观叙事正在被现金流检验。与此同时，安全事件密集出现——Cursor 插件后门、五角大楼网络里的个人 Agent、GLM 5.3 自主构造 Firefox 漏洞链，说明 Agent 能力提升的速度已经超过权限治理的速度。技术侧则相对活跃，统一训练、MTP 梯度修正、EasyProver 都在动基础配方，而"量化模型功能失效"和"专家盲从 Agent 观点"两篇论文提醒：可用的模型和可信的输出，都还需要额外验证。

items.title: Anthropic IPO 或获"垃圾级"信用评级
items.desc: FT 报道称，Blackstone 预计 Anthropic IPO 后难以获得投资级评级，高收益债市场将抬高其融资成本。
items.value: 直接影响前沿实验室的融资能力与算力扩张节奏

items.title: AI 资本开支担忧引发科技股大跌
items.desc: Reuters 与 BBC 报道，Amazon、Intel 财报加剧市场对 AI 投入回报的怀疑，纳指与科技板块显著下挫。
items.value: 融资环境收紧将传导至创业公司估值与招聘

items.title: OpenAI、Google、微软、Anthropic 联合支持 AI 抓取退出标准
items.desc: 四家将采纳统一的"policy token"信号，发布方可一次性向多家 AI 公司声明训练偏好，无需逐家配置。
items.value: 数据授权合规成本下降，爬虫策略需重新设计

items.title: Google 首个太空数据中心卫星上线
items.desc: 星上 TPU 成功启动，Gemma 4 模型在轨完成推理并输出一首关于太空的俳句。
items.value: 验证轨道算力可行性，为遥感/离线推理场景开路

items.title: Cursor 市场中的 Claude Code 扩展被植入后门约 11 小时
items.desc: 受影响用户最多 5,000 人，扩展尝试窃取数据并建立远程访问；Cursor 一度下架整个市场。
items.value: 插件供应链成为 Agent 工具链的新攻击面

items.title: 承包商个人 Claude Agent 在五角大楼网络运行两月
items.desc: WIRED 称 Accenture 员工的个人 Agent 在国防部网络潜伏两个月才被发现并修补。
items.value: 企业 Agent 部署的权限边界与审计缺口暴露

items.title: Reddit CEO：Google AI Mode"不给任何人导流"
items.desc: Huffman 称 Reddit 10 月每周流失超百万 Google 搜索引荐，股价跌逾 25%，将转向登录墙与直接访问。
items.value: 依赖搜索流量的内容业务模式面临结构性冲击

items.title: OpenAI 将 Pro 套餐用量上限翻倍
items.desc: Pro 100 升至 Pro 500，原计划削减 Pro 200 配额在用户反对后撤回，被视为对 Anthropic IPO 的正面竞争。
items.value: 重度 Agent 用户的单位成本下降，B2B 定价战升温

items.title: 美国司法部审查 Nvidia 收购 Hugging Face 交易
items.desc: 反垄断机构同时关注 Nvidia 的销售行为，交易前景存在不确定性。
items.value: 开源模型分发平台的归属将影响整个生态中立性

items.title: OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，围绕五大核心价值重构行为准则
items.desc: 新规范强调对人类意图的忠实与可纠正性，要求模型结合对话历史推断真实需求并披露自身假设。
items.value: 对齐规范从原则宣示转向可操作的推理行为约束

items.title: EasyProver 用现成前沿模型攻克 Lean 定理证明
items.desc: 无需额外训练，在 PutnamBench 上解出 669/672，完成 IMO 2026 全部六道形式化题，并解决 597/600 个 NTP4VC 验证条件。
items.value: 递归 Agent + 并行 tactic 搜索逼近形式化验证饱和

items.title: 统一训练：用单一似然算法覆盖预训练到 RL 全流程
items.desc: 论文将预训练、midtraining、SFT、RL 统一为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，消解阶段间的算法割裂。
items.value: 简化训练管线，为端到端基础模型训练提供新范式

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction 训练缺陷被定位并修正
items.desc: 作者分解出 MTP 交叉熵梯度中干扰下一 token 学习的残差项（本质为 KL 自蒸馏），随规模放大而加剧。
items.value: 直接改进主流预训练配方，提升投机解码收益

items.title: "Broken on Arrival"：公共模型库中大量量化模型功能失效
items.desc: 测试 Ollama 官方库 305 个可用于代码的 GGUF 标签，2.3% 的官方标签在 HumanEval+ 上最多只解出 6 题，且无仓库做功能测试。
items.value: 本地部署选型需自带功能验证，不能只看量化标签

items.title: Anthropic 研究：专家会采纳 AI Agent 的随机观点并误认为己见
items.desc: 50 名专家面对偏好由抛硬币决定的 Agent，在判断类问题上跟随其观点高达 86%。
items.value: Agent 建议的锚定效应被量化，产品设计需防谄媚与误导

items.title: Mistral 开源 Large 4「Le Chonk」
items.desc: 万亿参数、全程在欧洲训练的开放权重模型，官方称编码能力超越开源对手，但独立测试综合得分 26，落后 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 GLM-5.3 的 32。
items.value: 欧洲开放权重选项增强，编码场景可作低成本备选

items.title: Microsoft 与 UC Berkeley 发布 TokenEconomizer
items.desc: 开源插件从历史会话学习，在 SWE-Bench 上将编码 Agent 的 token 成本降低 18.4%–30.9%，无需改动 Agent 本身。
items.value: Agent 长任务成本可插拔式压缩，落地门槛低

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
items.desc: 开放权重语音 LLM，约 4.3B 激活参数、30B MoE，支持 40 种语言转写、说话人标签与词级时间戳，英文平均 WER 4.71%。
items.value: 开源转写质量逼近商用 API，可本地部署

items.title: Prime Intellect 发布 Prime Mega MoE
items.desc: 为 DeepSeek 的 fused Mega MoE kernel 补上反向传播，使其可训练，前向提速 3.11 倍，Qwen3 MoE 训练步速提升最多 34%。
items.value: MoE 训练效率提升，降低小团队训练门槛

items.title: claude-mem 登顶 GitHub Trending
items.desc: 为每个 Agent 提供跨会话持久上下文，自动压缩会话内容并将相关记忆注入后续会话，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等。
items.value: 解决 Agent 记忆断层，长周期项目可直接受益

items.title: Sam Altman：内存放在个人电脑里而非数据中心是"糟糕的"
items.desc: 在 Cheeky Pint 播客中，Altman 就 RAM 短缺表态，称大量内存留在消费端 PC 是浪费；他同时表示同情被 AI 数学成果淹没的研究者，但 OpenAI 的数学攻势不会停。
items.value: 反映算力资源争夺已延伸至消费级内存供应链

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA 热议：开源模型发布节奏沦为"抢榜一天"
items.desc: 社区预测各大实验室将在 Qwen 4 发布前突击推出本地模型以短暂占据榜首，并调侃 Gemma 4 此前正是在 Qwen 发布前几天落地；同期 Unsloth 发布 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GGUF，并公开质疑第三方量化版本复现不了其宣称的精度。
items.value: benchmark 军备竞赛与量化精度宣传的可信度受质疑

en.headline: AI spending fears trigger tech stock selloff
headline_alt: Anthropic IPO may get junk rating
Four major firms jointly launch AI scraping opt-out standard
en.observation: The clearest signal today is a double tightening of capital and trust: Anthropic's IPO could get a junk-grade rating, tech stocks fell collectively on AI spending concerns, and the optimistic financing narrative is being tested by cash flow. At the same time, security incidents are clustering—the Cursor plugin backdoor, personal Agents inside Pentagon networks, and GLM 5.3 autonomously constructing a Firefox exploit chain—showing that Agent capabilities are advancing faster than permission governance. The technical side is relatively active, with unified training, MTP gradient correction, and EasyProver all tinkering with base recipes, while two papers—"quantized models losing functionality" and "experts blindly following Agent opinions"—remind us that both usable models and trustworthy outputs still require extra verification.

items.title: Anthropic IPO may receive a "junk" credit rating
items.desc: FT reports that Blackstone expects Anthropic will struggle to obtain an investment-grade rating after its IPO, and the high-yield bond market will raise its financing costs.
items.value: Directly affects frontier labs' fundraising capacity and compute expansion pace

items.title: AI capex concerns trigger tech stock selloff
items.desc: Reuters and BBC report that Amazon and Intel earnings intensified market doubts about returns on AI investment, with the Nasdaq and tech sector falling sharply.
items.value: Tighter financing conditions will pass through to startup valuations and hiring

items.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic jointly support an AI scraping opt-out standard
items.desc: The four companies will adopt a unified "policy token" signal, allowing publishers to declare training preferences to multiple AI companies at once without configuring each one individually.
items.value: Data licensing compliance costs fall; crawler strategies need redesign

items.title: Google's first space data center satellite goes online
items.desc: The on-board TPU started successfully, and the Gemma 4 model completed inference in orbit and output a haiku about space.
items.value: Validates orbital compute feasibility, opening the way for remote sensing/offline inference

items.title: Claude Code extension in the Cursor marketplace was backdoored for about 11 hours
items.desc: Up to 5,000 users were affected; the extension attempted to steal data and establish remote access; Cursor temporarily took down the entire marketplace.
items.value: The plugin supply chain becomes a new attack surface for agent toolchains

items.title: Contractor's personal Claude Agent ran on Pentagon network for two months
items.desc: WIRED reports that an Accenture employee's personal Agent lurked on a Department of Defense network for two months before being discovered and patched.
items.value: Exposes permission boundaries and audit gaps in enterprise Agent deployments

items.title: Reddit CEO: Google AI Mode "doesn't drive traffic for anybody"
items.desc: Huffman says Reddit lost more than one million Google search referrals per week in October, shares fell over 25%, and the company will shift toward login walls and direct access.
items.value: Content business models reliant on search traffic face structural shock

items.title: OpenAI doubles usage limits on Pro plans
items.desc: Pro 100 rises to Pro 500; the originally planned cut to the Pro 200 quota was withdrawn after user opposition, seen as direct competition with Anthropic's IPO.
items.value: Unit costs fall for heavy Agent users; B2B pricing war heats up

items.title: US Department of Justice reviews Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face
items.desc: Antitrust authorities are also examining Nvidia's sales practices, and the deal's prospects are uncertain.
items.value: Ownership of the open-source model distribution platform will affect ecosystem neutrality

items.title: OpenAI updates Model Spec, restructuring behavior guidelines around five core values
items.desc: The new specification emphasizes fidelity to human intent and corrigibility, requiring models to infer true needs from conversation history and disclose their own assumptions.
items.value: Alignment shifts from stated principles to operational reasoning constraints

items.title: EasyProver tackles Lean theorem proving with off-the-shelf frontier models
items.desc: No additional training required; solves 669/672 on PutnamBench, completes all six formalized IMO 2026 problems, and resolves 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions.
items.value: Recursive agents plus parallel tactic search approach formal verification saturation

items.title: Unified training: a single likelihood algorithm covers the full pipeline from pretraining to RL
items.desc: The paper unifies pretraining, midtraining, SFT, and RL as maximum likelihood fitting to the model's target output distribution, eliminating algorithmic fragmentation between stages.
items.value: Simplifies training pipelines, offering a new paradigm for end-to-end foundation model training

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction training flaw identified and fixed
items.desc: The authors decompose a residual term in the MTP cross-entropy gradient that interferes with next-token learning (essentially KL self-distillation), which worsens as scale increases.
items.value: Directly improves mainstream pretraining recipes and boosts speculative decoding gains

items.title: "Broken on Arrival": many quantized models in public model libraries are functionally broken
items.desc: Testing 305 code-capable GGUF tags in Ollama's official library, 2.3% of official tags solved at most 6 problems on HumanEval+, and no repository performs functional testing.
items.value: Local deployment selection requires built-in functional verification, not just quantization labels

items.title: Anthropic study: experts adopt AI agents' random opinions and mistake them for their own
items.desc: Facing agents whose preferences were decided by coin flips, 50 experts followed their views on judgment-type questions up to 86% of the time.
items.value: Anchoring effects of agent advice are quantified; product design must prevent sycophancy and misleading

items.title: Mistral open-sources Large 4 "Le Chonk"
items.desc: A trillion-parameter open-weight model trained entirely in Europe; the company claims coding ability surpassing open-source rivals, but independent tests give it an overall score of 26, behind DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 at 32.
items.value: Adds a European open-weight option; a low-cost fallback for coding tasks

items.title: Microsoft and UC Berkeley release TokenEconomizer
items.desc: An open-source plugin that learns from past sessions and cuts coding-agent token costs on SWE-Bench by 18.4%–30.9% without modifying the agent itself.
items.value: Pluggable cost compression for long agent tasks, easy to adopt

items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
items.desc: An open-weight speech LLM with ~4.3B active parameters and 30B MoE, supporting transcription in 40 languages, speaker labels, and word-level timestamps, with 4.71% average English WER.
items.value: Open transcription nears commercial API quality and can run locally

items.title: Prime Intellect releases Prime Mega MoE
items.desc: Adds backpropagation to DeepSeek's fused Mega MoE kernel, making it trainable, with 3.11x faster forward passes and up to 34% faster training steps for Qwen3 MoE.
items.value: Boosts MoE training efficiency, lowering the barrier for small teams

items.title: claude-mem tops GitHub Trending
items.desc: Gives each agent persistent cross-session context by automatically compressing session content and injecting relevant memories into later sessions; compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and more.
items.value: Fixes agent memory gaps, directly benefiting long-running projects

items.title: Sam Altman: Keeping memory in personal computers rather than data centers is "terrible"
items.desc: On the Cheeky Pint podcast, Altman weighed in on the RAM shortage, saying that leaving large amounts of memory in consumer PCs is wasteful; he also expressed sympathy for researchers overwhelmed by AI's math results, but said OpenAI's math push will not stop.
items.value: Shows the compute scramble has spread to consumer memory supply chains

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA debate: Open model release cadence reduced to "one day at the top of the leaderboard"
items.desc: The community predicts major labs will rush out local models before Qwen 4 launches to briefly take the top spot, joking that Gemma 4 landed just days before a Qwen release; meanwhile Unsloth released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GGUF and publicly questioned whether third-party quantized versions can reproduce its claimed accuracy.
items.value: Benchmark arms race and quantization accuracy claims face credibility doubts
